mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL #{days} DAY AS date_value UNION ALL SELECT date_value + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM dates WHERE date_value < CURDATE() ) SELECT d.date_value AS date, r.module_type AS moduleType, COALESCE(SUM(r.count), 0) AS count FROM dates d LEFT JOIN ai_module_record r ON r.record_date = d.date_value GROUP BY d.date_value, r.module_type ORDER BY d.date_value, r.module_type;
